user.title: Connect a SmartLogger
user.description: Enter this SmartLogger's connection parameters. The documented logger unit ID is 0. Optional downstream profiles: meter:1, emi:2, inverter_remap:3 or emi_remap:4 (separate with commas or new lines).

reconfigure.title: Edit SmartLogger connection
reconfigure.description: Enter this SmartLogger's connection parameters. The documented logger unit ID is 0. Optional downstream profiles: meter:1, emi:2, inverter_remap:3 or emi_remap:4 (separate with commas or new lines).

variables.title: Select variables

progress.reading_registers: Reading the documented variables. Unsupported registers will be marked individually. This may take a few minutes with downstream devices.

error.cannot_connect: Could not communicate with the SmartLogger. Check host, port, unit ID, Modbus enablement and permitted client IP.
error.no_registers: The device responded but no documented SmartLogger register could be read. Check unit ID, address mode and firmware.
error.invalid_settings: Enter a name and host, and valid downstream profiles. Each address must be 1–247, appear only once, and not conflict with the logger's direct unit ID.
error.already_configured: This host, port and unit ID already have a connection.
error.invalid_selection: The variable selection contains an unknown register. Refresh and select again.

abort.already_configured: This SmartLogger connection is already configured.
